title: Separate observation RPC retirement from capture cleanup backstop and diagnostics
outcome: Observation delivery retirement has explicit bounded custody and a distinct incomplete-RPC outcome, without incorrectly classifying two producer calls as a source-capture cleanup failure.
acceptance: A deterministic in-flight observation delivery test covers both producer calls and proves shutdown classifies pending observation RPC custody separately from source capture cleanup.
The existing shutdown backstop is preserved without a new timeout knob, sleep or retry, and pending custody is not reported as complete.
